notes.title: Demo Patch #1
notes.notes:
The Demo has been out for only a few days now and already a few great players have found a couple of small areas that could use some improvement. That being said, here they are.
[list]
[*] Better GUI for indicating when the player is or is not healing at a campfire
[*] Quicker enemy attacks to make dodging feel a bit more robust
[*] Tavern-Keep Interactions smoothed out so that it feels better for the player to get there gold
[*] Special Easter Egg added in for the few players that think they can break the Demo Walls down ;p
[/list]
These are the few core issues that were sniffed out and fixed. Thanks again for every player and wishlister out there. As a Solo Developer working on there dream project it means the world!
